## Checks

- [ ] `ruff format` and `ruff check` are clean
- [ ] `python -m pyright` reports zero errors
- [ ] `pytest` passes, and `pytest -m slow` if the change touches planning or results
- [ ] Tests were written with the change, including a negative test for any new
      input-validation rule
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior, the request schema or the CLI changed
